Patches `litellm.completion` and `litellm.text_completion`, records both call sites, and asserts exactly one call to each.
Asserts the chat request preserved `messages == [{"role": "user", "content": "ping"}]`, confirming the chat path kept the message list.
Asserts text-mode rewrite to `prompt == "ping\n\nBEGIN RESPONSE:"`, rewritten model `text-completion-openai/my-text-model`, and passthrough `api_base`.
